categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Gaoxin Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer materials for cables. Its main product lines include special polyethylene and cross-linked polyethylene cable materials, special PVC cable materials, halogen-free low-smoke flame-retardant cable materials, general PVC cable materials, and chemically cross-linked cable materials, covering over 200 varieties. These products serve industries such as 5G, military, marine engineering, power, new energy, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer compounding and processing technologies with proprietary formulations and production processes. It has developed a comprehensive formula system and holds 43 patents, including 7 invention patents. Production employs automated batching, feeding, granulation, and packaging systems, with strict quality control at all stages. The company also collaborates with universities and research institutes to support innovation and product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises, listed companies, and foreign-invested enterprises in the cable industry. The products are widely used in sectors such as power grids, solar energy, nuclear power, wind energy, hydropower, rail transit, shipbuilding, mining, communications, construction, and aerospace. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with major cable manufacturers, often co-developing products tailored to customer needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated entirely within China, with no significant overseas revenue. It is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and has established a joint venture in South China to expand market presence and improve logistics efficiency. The company serves domestic markets and benefits from national infrastructure and energy projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Gaoxin operates in the midstream segment of the cable industry supply chain, producing polymer materials that serve as essential raw materials for cable insulation, shielding, and protection. It sources raw materials such as PVC, PE, and EVA resins, which are petrochemical derivatives, and supplies these to cable manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strengthening R&D to maintain and expand its technological edge, focusing on developing environmentally friendly, flame-retardant, and high-performance polymer materials for emerging applications like photovoltaic cables, wind energy cables, and military-grade cables. It plans to accelerate new product development and optimize existing formulations to meet evolving market demands. Collaboration with industry partners and academic institutions is emphasized to enhance innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of polymer cable materials, recognized at the point in time when products are delivered and accepted by customers. The company does not engage in subscription or licensing models but relies on product sales to industrial clients. Sales are predominantly domestic and based on contracts with major cable manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the few large-scale, product-diversified, and technologically advanced domestic producers of cable polymer materials in China. It competes in a mature and highly competitive industry where many small and less competitive players have exited. The company leverages its technical advantages and customer relationships to compete against both domestic and international brands, aiming to capture market share through product innovation and cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 383.77 million, a slight decrease of 1.23% from the previous year. It experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 24.34 million, reversing from a profit in 2023. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 329.15 million with equity of RMB 67.94 million. Despite recent losses, the company is investing in R&D and operational improvements to stabilize and grow its business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou Gaoxin emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced proprietary formulations, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. Its products offer superior extrusion performance, high flame retardancy, environmental compliance (halogen-free, low smoke), and excellent resistance to environmental stress cracking. The company’s ability to rapidly customize formulations to meet specific customer requirements and its strategic partnerships with leading cable manufacturers enhance its competitive position.
